name: Odyssey Ark
summary: Sound, remote and configurable keyboard-to-input source following.
capabilities: Discovers Samsung monitors on the local network
Reads identity and audio state directly over local HTTP
Changes volume and mute with identity checks and read-back
Pairs a local Samsung remote and stores its token in Keychain
Sends explicitly selected remote navigation keys without retry
Exports reviewed audio actions through the shared plugin SDK
Controls volume keys and the Nook HUD only when selected for a Mac audio output
Tests explicitly selected input commands once; transport delivery is not physical source confirmation
Uses explicitly permitted keyboard-choice events to request mapped, owner-verified monitor inputs; no startup replay or command retry
